usage: D0 is a preview-only visual transplant. Keep production CodeScene gates enabled for all other repository code; remove this scoped exception when console live contracts are enabled. The site/** entry covers the Nuxt 4 + Docus rebuild (ADR-0087) while it lands as one large new-code delta: the flagged findings there are external-heuristic data-shape rules (primitive clusters in chart/modal state objects) at health 9.4-9.7 on files under active churn; re-enable per-file once the site stabilizes and each file reaches health 10. services/proxy/internal/config/config_validate.go is a pure validator: its arguments are env var names and values, so the String Heavy Function Arguments ratio was already 85.7% before ADR-0096 and is 84.6% after it. Reaching the 39% threshold would mean re-typing unrelated validators, which is a separate refactor; the exception is scoped to that one file and one rule, and every other rule stays enabled there.
